mission: Alumnos / pagina docente: Map reusable Prometeo capabilities, PageKit, Prompt/Context OS, Capture, Change Threads, workers and shared owners that this surface should consume rather than duplicate.
useful_delta: Produced a source-grounded reuse map for the teacher surface that preserves single-owner boundaries instead of creating another subsystem. It identifies Universal Control, P4 Capture, Page Change Threads/RETURNs, Agent Runtime workers, Context Foundry/Context Packs, PageKit lineage, Classes Runtime and Student World Runtime as reusable owners/donors with explicit authority states. It also found a material authority mismatch: Classes Runtime v2 defaults PageKit v37 while the capability registry retains v26 as the stable class-player donor and v37 only as a selective donor. The safe product shape is therefore a thin orchestration/projection layer with capability-level imports and independent candidate gates.

artifacts.role: Durable capability reuse/ownership map with authority separation, contradictions, reopenable refs and deduplicated integration guidance

validation.method: Exact source reopening + post-write refetch + acceptance-criteria critique

non_obvious_findings: In inspected Catalog/Current authority there is no direct composite alumnos-teacher page-current; individual Alumnos pages plus shared runtimes imply composition/orchestration unless the parallel TRUTH lane supplies newer exact authority.

Classes Runtime v2 hard-defaults PageKit v37, but Capability Registry keeps stable class player/rollback donor at v26 and v37 as selective donor; candidate defaults must not silently become product authority.

Prompt/Context OS is not a reason to create a page-local monolith: inspected executable responsibilities already live across Context Foundry, Context Packs, Agent Runtime receipts and page/work-item truth.
Page Change durable RETURN/thread semantics plus P4 Capture allow teacher continuity without treating disposable worker chat as persistent product state.

consume_single_owner: Universal Control V5 for global shell/navigation
Page Change Thread/Feed + durable RETURN for page-scoped change continuity
rollback_or_selective_donor: PageKit v37 laser/object capabilities where explicitly justified

deduplication.reason: All Alumnos teacher sibling lanes (DISCOVER, INTENT, PLAN, RISK, TRUTH, UX) were already claimed during this run. Generic Page Change, Prompt OS and Worker Fabric archaeology lanes were also already claimed. Creating another opportunity would duplicate active work; their RETURNs should converge into PLAN/integration first.

source_freshness.concurrency_note: main advanced repeatedly under concurrent /wc workers; exact source refs and own exclusive claim were refreshed before persistence. Published runtime epoch lagged live main and was not treated as proof of source identity.

known_limits: This lane intentionally did not resolve the final teacher-surface product plan; PLAN/INTENT/TRUTH/RISK/UX sibling lanes are concurrently owned and should be merged by their authorized convergence path.
Absence of a direct alumnos-teacher current entry in this scoped inspection is not proof that no historical artifact exists; the parallel TRUTH lane owns deeper current-truth archaeology.
Candidate runtime reuse still requires integration tests and Human Acceptance appropriate to the target surface before any served promotion.
result_summary: COMPLETE: Alumnos teacher reuse map persisted and verified; safe architecture is composition over existing owners, with no duplicate owner/proposal and no authority promotion.
